title: 5 Investments Rich People NEVER Do! Worst Investments You Can Make! | #AajWithRaj Ep 13

money is safe and your money increases too link is in the description check it out No.3 ULIP this is a very dangerous investment keep away from it bankers will try to sell it to you this is a smart will go into insurance and some in assests like equity or debt on hearing this you will feel this is a great product 2 hits with 1 arrow meaning i will invest in 1 place and that will cover my investment and insurance too very good but that is the problem that when you mix both the things so due to this none of them will perform well because both top level performance isn't counted in it instead, buy mutual funds and insurance seperately now many people will say Raj you don't know nothing they will comment bad about me in comments stay mum you're blabbering what's this what's that but listen this is my personal opinion and for this opinion i have made this chart and I will explain you through it why i think this is a bad investment if we compare ULIP and Mutual funds then by investing in ULIP you can't withdraw money in 3 to 5 years but in mutual funds you can do it anytime you would have to pay some minimal charges but can be done when we talk about charges overall ULIP charges can be around 5 to 10 % which is very expensive in mutual funds 0.5 to 2% which is very less and transparency in ULIP everytime you won't every detail how your account is being handled or where your money is used in but in mutual fund your portfolio is clear you know about every changes so clearly mutual fund is much better than ULIP now let's compare ULIP with term life insurance plan if you talk about premium charges then ULIP fall under 25000 to 60000 which is very high term insurance plan between 4000 to 20000 which is which is affordable and very less and talking about life coverage amount so you will see the life coverage amount for ULIP that is generally 10-15x of your annual premium amount that means you will get only 10-15lacs whereas life coverage amount in term insurance plan is upto 1 crore meaning if you do a small or affordable product of term life insurance plan then that gives 1 crore life coverage thats why rather than investing in ULIP invest it
